question: A music app wants the best 30-minute stretch of listening time out of the last 100,000 minutes. After the first stretch, what is the least work to get the next stretch's total?
options: Add the minute that enters and subtract the minute that leaves
Look up the total in a hash map
explanation: Neighbouring stretches share 29 minutes, so one addition and one subtraction update the total. The whole scan is O(n) instead of O(n · k).
